calculation.description: Ranks assets whose recent 20-day return exceeds or lags their 60-day return; positive values represent short-term strength relative to medium-term trend and are used as a cross-sectional reversal/acceleration signal for the 20-trading-day forward horizon. All prices are lagged to the completed signal date.

validation.regime_notes: Positive IC and ICIR across 2020-2022, 2023-2026, 2027-2030, and 2031-2034 at the 20-day horizon. H10 also positive but below the ICIR gate; recent H10 performance is weak, so use the validated 20-day horizon and monitor drift. Small 15-asset cross-section implies conservative interpretation of uncertainty.
